task.title: Update the admin shell and wire personal security settings
task.input: M3-T3 account-owner sensitive APIs, M3-T5 SELF_REAUTH, and M3-T6 account client; existing AdminShell/page access; section 11 admin DENSITY7 specification.
task.output: Unified AdminShell; /admin/account, AccountContainer/ReauthDialog, actual-activity reporting; personal sign-in mode/password/re-enrollment controls and role-based navigation.
task.accept: 1) Entry: the admin account menu's Personal information (admin-account-link) -> /admin/account. Data source: GET /api/admin/account. Clicking login-mode-toggle first sends POST reauth then PATCH login-mode; change-password first reauth then POST password; change-authenticator first reauth then POST 2fa/reset -> Continue setup enters /admin-recovery. Each button test asserts purpose/target and the real change/re-authentication. The ordinary passwordless form does not gain a password field (E-06, E-07, E-09, E-72, E-73, E-75). 2) AdminSessionActivity sends POST /api/admin/account/session/activity only after actual visible user activity, throttled to 15 minutes; page polling does not renew the session. A 401 clears this account's snapshots and in-flight requests. An expired grant returns to identity verification. Safely read back unknown sensitive-write outcomes (E-68, E-70, E-74). 3) The shell's current-role navigation agrees with page gates, and tokens have one source. On the real service at 1920x1080/1440x900/390x844, check D1-D6 using form, density7/gutter16/gap16/pad16. Include control-click, focus, and real-flow GIF evidence.
